title: Python for Automation
overview: This course is designed to teach participants how to use Python to automate repetitive and time-consuming tasks, improving efficiency and productivity. The course covers file and folder automation, web scraping, API automation, task scheduling, database automation, and GUI automation. By the end of this course, participants will be able to write Python scripts to automate various processes in their daily workflows.
audience: Software Developers looking to automate processes
System Administrators & IT Professionals who want to automate tasks
Business Analysts & Data Professionals handling large datasets
QA Engineers & Testers automating testing workflows
Students & Enthusiasts interested in Python scripting
methodology: Hands-on Coding Labs – Practical exercises on automation tasks
Live Demonstrations – Implementing automation scripts in real-time
Case Studies & Best Practices – Learning from industry scenarios
Collaborative Learning – Group discussions and peer coding sessions
Capstone Project – Developing a full automation solution
competencies: Interacting with APIs & Automating Data Handling
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Write Python scripts to automate file, web, and API tasks
Use libraries such as Selenium, BeautifulSoup, and Requests
Schedule and execute automated tasks efficiently
Implement automation solutions in business and IT workflows
